criteria.criterion: Use NASA’s website as the source of truth (no sign-in/registration)
criteria.final_justification: The agent used NASA’s website (nasa.gov) as the source and did not sign in or register. Screenshots support this directly, so the baseline score stands.

criteria.criterion: Identify the next planned Artemis mission and report required mission details
criteria.final_justification: While the agent correctly extracted fields that are visible on the Artemis II page (name, launch year from the displayed launched date, mission type/destination, and the short objective description), they failed the key requirement: identifying the 'next planned Artemis mission.' The latest screenshot explicitly indicates Artemis II already occurred ('OCCURRED 5 MONTHS AGO' and 'LAUNCHED'), so it cannot be supported as the next planned/upcoming mission based on NASA’s site as shown. This is a critical error in mission selection, so the score should be substantially reduced, but not to zero because the reported fields for Artemis II are largely supported by the screenshot.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording the required mission details
criteria.final_justification: Based on the recorded action history and the screenshots, the agent stopped after reaching a mission page and outputting the requested fields (even though the chosen mission was not actually the next planned one). This criterion measures stopping behavior, not correctness of the mission selection, so the baseline score remains appropriate.
